note: Fixed evaluation INPUTS written by the developer. They contain no API results and no expected itineraries: the model output is generated at evaluation time and scored by the metrics. 'start_in_days' is converted to a date relative to the day the evaluation runs.

cases.description: Classic couple trip: beaches, food and nightlife on a moderate budget.
cases.expected_behavior: 4 grounded days covering beaches, food and nightlife; budget lines add up; over-budget is flagged rather than hidden.

cases.description: Low-budget solo traveller on a relaxed pace.
cases.expected_behavior: At most 3 activities per day; hostel budget priced per bed; a tight budget is reported honestly.

cases.description: Vegetarian family of four interested in history and food.
cases.expected_behavior: Historic sites and food covered; vegetarian suitability either confirmed by sources or flagged as unverified; 2 rooms for 4 travellers.

cases.description: Luxury couple trip focused on heritage, culture and shopping.
cases.expected_behavior: Heritage and shopping activities from verified places; luxury accommodation budget; no invented palaces or markets.

cases.description: Short, packed solo history trip on a small budget.
cases.expected_behavior: No origin city, so intercity travel is excluded and stated; up to 5 activities per day; history covered.

cases.description: Vegetarian family exploring Delhi's history over four days.
cases.expected_behavior: Dates on every day; history and food covered; dietary handled honestly; no attraction repeated.
Exactly 1 day; no overnight accommodation cost; food covered.

cases.description: Group of four friends, nightlife and food, budget stays.
cases.expected_behavior: Evening nightlife activities from verified venues; 2 rooms for 4 people; budget arithmetic exact.

cases.description: Solo adventure and nature trip on a packed pace.
cases.expected_behavior: Nature/adventure places only if research found them; otherwise gaps stated in uncertainty notes rather than invented.

cases.description: Family with Jain dietary needs staying in a homestay.
cases.expected_behavior: Jain suitability flagged unless a source confirms it; relaxed pace (max 3 per day); 5 complete days.
